era_description: Legacy Cold War field artillery MOS. Pershing 1a and Pershing II crews served primarily in West Germany under the 56th Field Artillery Brigade, later 56th Field Artillery Command, from 1963 until the unit stood down in 1991 following the 1987 INF Treaty. The modern 15E, Unmanned Aircraft Systems Repairer, is an unrelated job that reuses the code. NOTE ON RADIATION: crews worked around nuclear warheads, and that is a documentable exposure through your own dosimetry and DD Form 1141 records, but Pershing duty is NOT one of the presumptive radiation-risk activities the VA lists. It has to be established from your records rather than assumed. Add your German duty stations in the Exposure Calculator for anything tied to where you served.
